CHRIS’ CRITTERS RIDE PLAYOFF WIN OVER CHRISTIE’S
FERRARIS TO RECORD-TYING 7TH PFPI CHAMPIONSHIP

          Chris’ Critters survived a marital playoff with Christie’s Ferraris to win the PFPI 2025 championship. The playoff fittingly ended the closest, most hotly contested regular season in league history, with five of eight teams within two games of the lead.

          Critters finished 9-3 in playoff to Ferraris’ 7-5, clinching the season crown in Conference Championship round in only the third playoff in league history. The Critters championship is team’s seventh and first since 2021, tying Dick’s Roughriders for most titles in modern era. The Ferraris were denied their first league championship.

          The champ will be awarded the Dad’s Dynamics Cup and honored at upcoming PFPI Gala & Awards Ceremony and Champion’s Dinner. A Gala date has not yet been set.
